description: This file defines the navigation graph for an Android Compose application, setting up routes and destinations such as Home and Details screens, and manages navigation between them using a NavHostController.

classes.name: Routes
classes.description: Defines string constants for navigation routes and a method to generate dynamic route for details page.

methods.name: details
methods.description: Constructs a route string for the Details page with a specific item ID.

methods.name: AppNavGraph
methods.description: Composable function that sets up the navigation graph, defining navigation destinations and their associated Composable screens.
